description: This file is a JUnit test class for the EngineChartParser and related classes in the com.rusefi.waves package. It contains several unit tests verifying the parsing of engine waveforms, duty cycles, and revolutions log handling.

classes.name: EngineChartParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EngineChartParser, verifying correct parsing of engine wave data and duty cycles.

methods.name: testMultiParser
methods.description: Tests parsing of a multi-channel engine waveform string and verifies timing and index data of engine reports.

methods.name: testDutyCycle
methods.description: Tests parsing of a complex engine waveform string with multiple injector and spark events, verifying duty cycles and crank angles.

methods.name: testUpOnly
methods.description: Tests parsing of a simple string with only 'up' events, expecting an empty list as output.
